_comment: Settings for the reusable importers in scripts/importers/. Locality names as each dataset spells them; a value forces the area key, null lets the nearest hand-assigned records decide.

areaAnchors._comment: Approximate anchor points per area (lat,lng), chosen at well-known places in each area; nearest anchor decides. West Kelowna is decided by locality, these only catch what has none.

names._source: Official school names confirmed on the schools' own sites and the SD23 directory, desk check 2026-10-04

arcgis_parks.licence: Open Government Licence – City of Kelowna
offLeashArea: On leash and off leash area
arcgis_parks._note: City of Kelowna only — West Kelowna, Lake Country and Peachland publish their own park data (not yet imported).

categoriesNotCollected._why: Kamloops has these categories; Kelowna deliberately leaves them out of the first release. Commercial places that any map app lists, that change often and that no official source vouches for: listing a few would look complete without being so, and every stale one costs trust (methodology principle 8). Revisit if search_empty shows people looking for them.
categoriesNotCollected.restaurant: commercial, hundreds in the city; not newcomer-critical
categoriesNotCollected.gas: commercial; every map app lists them
categoriesNotCollected.hardware: commercial; every map app lists them
categoriesNotCollected.usedcar: commercial; risk of seeming to recommend a dealer
categoriesNotCollected.autorepair: commercial; risk of seeming to recommend a garage
categoriesNotCollected.tutor: commercial; free tutoring (Project Literacy, library English Corner) is listed under its own categories
